questions.q: What nickname did the crew use for Long John Silver?
choices: Barbecue
Cap'n Flint
Old Salt
Peg-leg
questions.evidence: Now, Barbecue, tip us a stave

questions.q: Why did the crew's song carry Jim back to the Admiral Benbow?
choices: It was the same song the old captain used to sing
It was a song his father taught him
The inn's name was in the song
His mother sang it to him at night
questions.evidence: I seemed to hear the voice of the captain piping in the chorus

questions.q: What problem did Mr. Arrow have on the voyage?
choices: He was often drunk and had no command over the men
He was seasick the whole time
He kept getting the ship lost
He fought with Silver every day
Where Mr. Arrow got his drink
Who had stolen the map
Where the parrot came from
Why the captain disliked the squire
questions.evidence: we could never make out where he got the drink. That was the ship's mystery.

questions.q: What happened to Mr. Arrow one dark night?
choices: He disappeared overboard and was never seen again
He was locked in irons
He was made captain
He jumped into a lifeboat and rowed away
questions.evidence: he disappeared entirely and was seen no more

questions.q: Who served in a way as mate after Mr. Arrow was gone?
choices: Job Anderson, the boatswain
Israel Hands
Long John Silver
Tom Redruth
questions.evidence: The boatswain, Job Anderson, was the likeliest man aboard

questions.q: How did Silver manage to cross the deck in heavy weather?
choices: He used lines rigged up across the deck, called "Long John's earrings"
Other sailors carried him
He crawled on his hands and knees
He stayed in the galley and never crossed
questions.evidence: Long John's earrings, they were called

questions.q: What did Israel Hands tell Jim about Silver?
choices: He was educated and braver than a lion
He was a coward who feared the sea
He could not read or write
He was the squire's cousin
questions.evidence: a lion's nothing alongside of Long John!

questions.q: What did Silver name his parrot?
choices: Cap'n Flint
Pieces of Eight
Billy Bones
Admiral Hawke
questions.evidence: I calls my parrot Cap'n Flint, after the famous buccaneer

Tar is hard to clean off a ship
You should never touch a parrot
Sailors must keep their hands clean
questions.evidence: you can't touch pitch and not be mucked, lad

questions.q: How did the squire feel about Captain Smollett during the voyage?
choices: He despised him

He feared him
He felt sorry for him

questions.q: Why did the captain think spoiling the crew with double grog and treats was a bad idea?
choices: He believed it would turn the men into devils

He wanted the treats for himself

questions.q: Why did Jim climb into the apple barrel just after sundown?

He was hiding from the captain
He was told to clean it
He wanted to spy on Silver
questions.evidence: it occurred to me that I should like an apple

He was stuck in the barrel
